meta.name: Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori
aliases: Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori
Where the Sky and the Red River Meet
meta.description: After a mysterious hand drags her beneath a puddle, modern Japanese teenager Yuri awakens in the Hittite Empire of the 14th century BCE. Thrust into a deadly struggle for the throne, she joins Prince Kail to battle assassins, outwit royal conspiracies, and survive a world at war. As her exploits earn her renown as the goddess Ishtar, Yuri must choose between her old life and an uncertain future.

videos.title: A Goodbye Kiss, a Hello Kiss
videos.overview: Yuri is an ordinary teenage girl, until she's dragged to the ancient Hittite Empire—and marked for sacrifice!

videos.title: The Black Water
videos.overview: Yuri discovers that the only way to return home is to risk her life and retrieve her old clothes from Nakia.

videos.title: I Can't Go Back, I Won't Go Back
videos.overview: Yuri finally has everything she needs to go home. But Tito's fate changes everything she's fighting for.

videos.title: Ishtar Incarnate
videos.overview: Yuri accompanies Kail to battle in Alinna, where she faces danger from foes and purported friends alike!

videos.title: A Sword to Fight
videos.overview: A mysterious old man forces Yuri to battle the ruthless warrior Zuwa, with the weapon of her choosing.

videos.title: The One I Can't Love
videos.overview: Prince Zannanza is struck by a spell from Nakia that drives him to act on his darkest desires.

videos.title: Cold Lips
videos.overview: Ambushed by the Prince of Darkness, Yuri has to cut through enemy lines to save the kingdom of Kizzuwatna.

videos.title: Under the Apple Tree
videos.overview: Kail is ordered to destroy the Mitanni, but he refuses to let Yuri join him until Zannanza intervenes.

videos.title: The Sign on the Palm
videos.overview: The Dark Prince has occupied Malatya, but Kail and Yuri slip inside the city to bring it down.

videos.title: Ishtar Purloined
videos.overview: The Dark Prince takes Yuri prisoner, and he condemns her to death in a coliseum to prove she's not Ishtar.

videos.title: Where My Heart Is
videos.overview: Held captive in the Dark Prince's harem, Yuri plots her escape while the top concubine plots her murder.

videos.title: The Appointed Time
videos.overview: The Prince of Darkness has taken Yuri hostage to save himself. Will Kail rescue Yuri in time to send her home?

videos.title: A Letter From Egypt
videos.overview: The widowed queen of Egypt seeks to wed a Hittite prince, and the groom will be chosen by a chariot race!

videos.title: The Arrow Wound of Grief
videos.overview: The Hittites are about to go to war with the Egyptians over Zannanza's death, and it's up to Yuri to stop it!

videos.title: The False Ishtar
videos.overview: After a deadly epidemic takes the king's life, a fake Ishtar appears to smear Kail's reputation.

videos.title: The Oath at the Grave
videos.overview: A woman from Kail's past arrives with a son and a secret that shocks the royal court—and Yuri.

videos.title: A New Conspiracy
videos.overview: Ursula uncovers a sinister plot led by Queen Nakia, but Yuri’s attempt to stop it goes awry.

videos.title: Proof of Innocence
videos.overview: Accused of murdering the king, Yuri flees to Alinna as Kail works to prove her innocence.

videos.title: Dream of That Wonderful Day
videos.overview: Kail's power struggle with Nakia hits an impasse, and Yuri is suddenly kidnapped by Ramses.
